instruments.name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

facet_hints.mapping: This pack is the vocabulary phase 4 maps its AI findings onto. Confirm the current edition's item numbering and titles before labelling a finding, because the list has been renumbered between editions.
facet_hints.usage: Every AI finding should carry an LLM item where one fits, so security and legal reviewers can talk about the same thing.

seed_obligations.title: Mitigate prompt injection, direct and indirect
applies_when: untrusted content reaches a model prompt
testable_as: untrusted input is delimited and never concatenated into instructions
tool calls are authorised independently of model output

seed_obligations.title: Handle model output as untrusted before it reaches a sink
applies_when: model output reaches HTML, SQL, a shell, or a tool call
testable_as: output encoded or validated at each sink
no direct rendering of model output as HTML

seed_obligations.title: Prevent personal data from reaching prompts, logs, or the vendor unnecessarily
applies_when: personal data can enter a prompt
testable_as: field-level control over what enters a prompt
prompt logs scrubbed of personal data
a recorded legal basis for what does reach the vendor

seed_obligations.title: Constrain what a model-triggered tool call is permitted to do
applies_when: the model can trigger a tool, function or API call
testable_as: an audit trail of tool invocations
